Reorder joins to reduce intermediate rows
reached_sql:
WITH filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d.d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim AS d
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
),
filtered_bill_demographics AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cd1.cd_demo_sk, cd1.cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics AS cd1
    WHERE cd1.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
filtered_current_customer_demographics AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c.c_customer_sk,
        c.c_current_cdemo_sk,
        c.c_current_addr_sk,
        c.c_birth_year
    FROM customer AS c
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2
        ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4)
),
filtered_customer_addresses AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        f.c_customer_sk,
        f.c_birth_year,
        ca.ca_country,
        ca.ca_state,
        ca.ca_county
    FROM filtered_current_customer_demographics AS f
    JOIN customer_address AS ca
        ON f.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA')
),
aggregated_results AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        i.i_item_id,
        a.ca_country,
        a.ca_state,
        a.ca_county,
        avg(cast(cs.cs_quantity AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg1,
        avg(cast(cs.cs_list_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg2,
        avg(cast(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg3,
        avg(cast(cs.cs_sales_price AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg4,
        avg(cast(cs.cs_net_profit AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg5,
        avg(cast(a.c_birth_year AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg6,
        avg(cast(cd1.cd_dep_count AS decimal(12,2))) AS agg7
    FROM catalog_sales AS cs
    JOIN filtered_dates AS d
        ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item AS i
        ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN filtered_bill_demographics AS cd1
        ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN filtered_customer_addresses AS a
        ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = a.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (
        i.i_item_id,
        a.ca_country,
        a.ca_state,
        a.ca_county
    )
)
SELECT
    i_item_id,
    ca_country,
    ca_state,
    ca_county,
    agg1,
    agg2,
    agg3,
    agg4,
    agg5,
    agg6,
    agg7
FROM aggregated_results
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
